_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNx?thread=cmsg_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNxR1z3N3pSCkLgjLSvvp72rM)_

Fixes #28342
Part of #27377

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:只改 `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` 一个文件:三条过时的环境说明按今天的代码改正,另加一条"共享检出要用 `--no-compile` 启动"的环境规则。
- **为什么改**:v18.3.0 第三波测试发现这几处说明和代码对不上,跑测的 agent 会照着错的说明走弯路或误报缺陷。
- **风险与回滚**:纯文档,不动产品代码、不发布;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`RUNNER.md` 新增的 `--no-compile` 条目;地图条目(#25889 之后改为列表);cookie 条目里新增的 Packaged Automation 页面。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`,预期打印 `check-platform-checklist: OK`。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Each row was re-verified against `origin/main` at `488b3ed0` before editing; all four still held, so none is reported as fixed upstream.

| census row | run record | RUNNER entry | what the code says today |
|---|---|---|---|
| 61 | #27409 | the cookie note ("The cookie is not decorative") | The Setup app's Packaged Automation page (`automation:packaged`) sends every request as a bare `fetch` with `credentials: 'include'` and no `Authorization` header (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PackagedAutomationPage.tsx`, `fetchRuntimeStates` / `fetchFlowMetadata` / toggle / clone). A token-only session renders a load failure ending `HTTP 401` in the page's alert box. The note now names this page beside storage. |
| 68 | #27409 | the objectui `automated.ref` entry (jsdom unit suite command) | `pnpm --filter @object-ui/PKG exec vitest run` runs in the package directory, and `ui/scripts/vitest-invocation-guard.mjs` (called by `ui/vitest.config.mts`) refuses any run whose Vitest root is not `ui/`. The entry now gives `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/PKG/src/FILE.test.ts` and names the refused form. |
| 198 | #27438 | the map banner entry | Since #25889 a style-load failure unmounts the map and shows the record list (`data-testid="map-style-fallback"`): the amber alert banner, a "Try the map again" button and a "Locations" list built from `filteredMarkers`. There is no canvas and no marker element (`ui/packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx`). The entry now describes the list, gives the current banner wording, names `OS_CONSOLE_MAP_STYLE_URL` as the deployment's style rung, and says what to score. |
| added (comment 6539852711) | #27481 | new environment fact: boot with `--no-compile` on a shared checkout | A default `os dev` compiles `objectstack.config.ts` into `CWD/dist/objectstack.json` before it starts (`devCompilesAtBoot()` in `packages/cli/src/utils/dev-compile-at-boot.ts`), and its watch loop recompiles into the same file (`startWatchRecompile()` in `packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts`). The path resolves against the working directory, not `OS_HOME`, so `--fresh` does not isolate it. One rule covers every item whose `fixtures.requires` carries `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p PORT --seed-admin`. As the card says, none of the 37 items is edited. |

Each edit makes a clause more precise, and none is weakened. The `--no-compile` rule keeps the caveats the code imposes: a missing artifact is still compiled, a stale artifact draws a warning, and `--no-compile` does not stop the watch loop, so the rule also adds `--no-watch` for trees where someone may be editing sources.

## Tests

Docs only. No test applies, and no ablation is owed because no tested behaviour changed.

## Acceptance notes

- Edit shape: `RUNNER.md` carries no `revision` / `history` (those exist only on the area-file items), so the card's "revision +1, one history row" shape has nothing to apply to here. The run records are cited inline in each entry instead.
- Changeset: none. This is a docs-only change under `docs/qa/` and nothing in it is published. Label `skip-changeset`.
- No product defect was found on reading. All four findings were stale text.
